claims.text_ko: 공동 피고인 쑨은 2026년 10월 9일 유죄를 인정했다.
claims.support: Fortune: 'One of the three charged pleaded guilty in October'; DCD/TNW: Sun pleaded guilty Oct 9, 2026 to four counts
claims.note: Date from search summaries; Fortune confirms October.

claims.text_ko: 슈퍼마이크로 법인은 기소되지 않았고 스스로 피해자라며 수사에 협조한다고 밝혔다.
claims.support: Fortune 11/10: Supermicro was not charged; says it was a victim of the scheme and is cooperating; Fortune 5/13: 'Neither Supermicro nor any of its other executives were named in the case'

claims.text_ko: 블룸버그 등은 통과 법인(회사-1)을 방콕의 AI 인프라 기업 OBON으로 지목했다.
claims.support: TNW: 'Bloomberg's sources identify OBON' ... 'a Bangkok-based AI infrastructure firm'; Fortune: Bloomberg and Culper identified the front company as OBON
claims.note: Identification comes from anonymous sourcing / short seller, not the indictment (which says 'Company-1').

claims.text_ko: OBON은 기소되지 않았다.
claims.support: OBON has not been charged

claims.text_ko: 슈퍼마이크로 공소장은 엔비디아의 위법을 주장하지 않으며, 엔비디아는 전용된 시스템에 서비스·지원을 하지 않는다고 밝혔다.
claims.support: 'Nvidia does not provide any service or support for such systems.'
claims.note: Nvidia not named as defendant in any case reviewed.

claims.text_ko: 텍사스 하오글로벌 대표 앨런 하오 쉬와 회사는 2025년 10월 10일 밀수·불법 수출 혐의를 인정했다.
claims.support: Alan Hao Hsu and Hao Global LLC pleaded guilty on October 10, 2025, to smuggling and unlawful export activity
claims.note: Plea was under seal; made public Dec 8, 2025. Sentencing set for Feb 18 (2026).

claims.text_ko: 미 법무부는 2025년 12월 8일 '게이트키퍼 작전'으로 이 밀수망을 차단했다고 발표했다.
claims.support: Operation Gatekeeper (announced Monday, December 8, 2025), Southern District of Texas

claims.text_ko: 검찰은 2024년 10월~2025년 5월 H100·H200 최소 1억 6,000만 달러어치를 반출했거나 반출하려 했다고 밝혔다.
claims.support: From October 2024 to May 2025 ... exported or attempted to export at least $160 million in H100 and H200 GPUs
claims.note: Admitted in Hsu's plea, so stronger than pure allegation for Hsu; A&P does not give the date range.

claims.text_ko: 수법은 대리 구매자, 미국 내 창고, 엔비디아 라벨 제거 후 가짜 회사 이름으로 바꿔 달기였다고 검찰은 밝혔다.
claims.support: used straw purchasers ... sent chips to U.S. warehouses ... removed Nvidia labels and relabeled the chips under a fictitious company name
claims.note: Describes the network; co-defendants not convicted.

claims.text_ko: 검찰은 이 계획에 중국에서 5,000만 달러가 넘는 송금이 들어왔다고 밝혔다.
claims.support: received more than $50 million in wire transfers from China to fund the scheme
claims.note: In DOJ release, not in Arnold & Porter blog (brief cites A&P only).

claims.text_ko: 같은 작전으로 벤린 위안(11월 28일 체포)과 판웨 '톰' 궁(12월 3일 체포)이 기소됐다.
claims.support: Benlin Yuan arrested November 28 ... Fanyue (Tom) Gong arrested December 3
claims.note: Search summaries say both pleaded not guilty.

claims.text_ko: 플로리다 사건에서 검찰은 탬파의 '재너드 리얼터'가 부동산 거래를 한 적 없는 위장 회사였다고 주장한다.
claims.support: Despite its name, Janford Realtor, LLC, was never involved in any real estate transactions.
claims.note: DOJ release Nov 20, 2025 (Middle District of Florida); defendants Hon Ning Ho, Brian Curtis Raymond, Cham Li, Jing Chen.

claims.text_ko: 검찰은 2024년 10월~2025년 1월 A100 400개가 말레이시아·태국을 거쳐 중국으로 갔다고 주장한다.
claims.support: '400 NVIDIA A100 GPUs being exported to the PRC'; 'through Malaysia and Thailand'
claims.note: Brief says '약 400개'; source says 400.

claims.text_ko: 플로리다 사건의 HPE 슈퍼컴퓨터 10대(H100)와 H200 50개 반출 시도는 저지됐다.
claims.support: 'ten Hewlett Packard Enterprises supercomputers containing NVIDIA H100 GPUs'; 'will also seek forfeiture of 50 NVIDIA H200 GPUs'

claims.text_ko: 조지아 사건은 2026년 3월 조지아 북부지검이 중국인 1명과 미국인 2명을 기소한 사건이다.
claims.support: Complaints issued March 20, 2026 in N.D. Georgia; release March 25, 2026; Stanley Yi Zheng, Matthew Kelly, Tommy Shad English
claims.note: Charged by criminal complaint (not indictment at time of release).

claims.text_ko: 검찰은 이들이 태국 회사를 구매자로 내세우고 중국행이 아니라는 증명서에 서명했다고 주장한다.
claims.support: Fortune: 'faking the end-user certifications and routing orders through phony buyers in Thailand'; DOJ: signed an 'Advanced Computing Certification' and later an 'End User Certification'

claims.text_ko: 켈리가 그럴듯한 웹사이트와 사업 자료, 재무 기록이 있는 다른 회사를 언급했다고 검찰은 주장한다.
claims.support: 'another company had a legit-looking website with pitch decks and financial records'
claims.note: DOJ: June 2023, English said he had faked corporate materials.

claims.text_ko: 정은 메시지로 '중국에 관해서는 아무것도 언급하지 마라'고 했다고 검찰은 주장한다.
claims.support: "DO NOT MENTION ANYTHING ABOUT CHINA"
claims.note: Reply to a March 2024 draft solicitation mentioning Chinese customers; brief's '중국 언급을 지우자' is a fair paraphrase.

claims.text_ko: 2023년 10월 서버 750대, 약 1억 7,000만 달러 주문은 판매·칩 회사의 점검에 걸려 성사되지 않았다.
claims.support: Fortune: 'English allegedly placed a purchase order for 750 servers for $170 million' ... 'That purchase failed due to one unnamed company's compliance controls.'
claims.note: DOJ: Company-1 (server maker, Supermicro per The Register) raised red flags and Company-2 (chip maker, Nvidia per The Register) could not verify the Thai end user.

claims.text_ko: 대만 지룽 지검은 2026년 8월 24일 엔비디아 대만 지사 관리자 장 씨 등을 기소했다.
claims.support: Focus Taiwan: Keelung District Prosecutors' Office filed the indictments (Aug 24); 'a distribution manager surnamed Chang (張) at Nvidia Corp.'s Taiwan office'
claims.note: Title varies: 'senior manager' (TNW), 'distribution manager' (CNA), 'senior partner manager' (AP). Defendant count: 9 (AP, TNW) vs '8 indicted' (CNA headline).

claims.text_ko: 장 씨는 2026년 7월 구금됐다.
claims.support: Chang was detained in July and indicted in August
claims.note: Detention after a July 24 search.

claims.text_ko: 검찰은 B300 칩을 실은 서버 74대가 중국으로 갔다고 주장한다.
claims.support: '74 servers containing B300 chips'
claims.note: Chip: B300 (CNA, TNW, AP). Some secondary reports say GB300.

claims.text_ko: 중국행 서버는 인도네시아, 그리고 일본과 홍콩을 거쳤다고 검찰은 주장한다.
claims.support: 'Of those, 50 were shipped to China via Indonesia.'; 'eight were shipped to Japan and then Hong Kong for delivery to Chinese buyers'
claims.note: Brief omits Hong Kong; route via Japan continued to Hong Kong.

claims.text_ko: 나머지 서버 56대는 출항 전에 대만 당국이 압수했다.
claims.support: 'another 56 were seized before they could leave'; Taiwan News: '56 servers intercepted by the Coast Guard in May'
claims.note: Discrepancy: Focus Taiwan's May 22 report on the May 20 raid said 50 servers were seized; the 56 figure appears in the August indictment coverage.

claims.text_ko: 장 씨의 죄명은 문서 위조와 배임이며 검찰은 최대 5년형을 구형했다.
claims.support: 'forgery and breach of trust'
claims.note: Some co-defendants also charged with aggravated breach of trust under the Securities and Exchange Act.

claims.text_ko: 블룸버그는 엔비디아가 대만 정치권 인사들에게 장 씨 기소에 이의를 전하고 TSMC에도 조언을 구했다고 보도했다.
claims.support: Nvidia approached Taiwanese political officials ... argued Chang should not have been investigated; TSMC declined to get involved
claims.note: Anonymous sourcing via Bloomberg; officials said they had no role.

claims.text_ko: 엔비디아는 자사 직원이 다른 회사 직원들의 전용 시도를 알았다는 정황은 없다고 밝혔다.
claims.support: 'found no indication that our employee knew of the alleged diversion effort by employees at other companies'

claims.text_ko: Epoch AI는 2025년 말까지 중국에 밀반입된 연산력을 H100 환산 66만 개로 추정했다(90% 구간 29만~160만).
claims.support: Our model estimates 660,000 (90% CI: 290,000–1.6 million) H100e of cumulative compute smuggled through the end of 2025.
claims.note: Model estimate; Epoch notes ~3% of global compute stockpile. CI is a 90% credible/confidence interval as Epoch labels it 'CI'.

claims.text_ko: 기소·보도로 드러난 전용·실종 칩은 2025년 말까지 H100 환산 30만 개에 조금 못 미친다.
claims.support: Cumulative allegations of diverted or missing chips total almost 300,000 H100e by the end of 2025
claims.note: 'almost 300,000' — brief's '약 30만 개' is fine.

claims.text_ko: Epoch은 혐의 대부분이 법정에서 입증되지 않았고 일부 칩은 중국에 닿지 않았을 수 있다고 한계를 밝혔다.
claims.support: the allegations are largely not yet proven in a court of law ... some of the chips redirected to China may not have arrived there
claims.note: Also: 'A 10% detection rate and a 80% detection rate imply very different totals' (sensitivity to detection rate).

claims.text_ko: Epoch은 중국 안에서 수출통제 칩을 파는 것이 불법이 아니라고 썼다.
claims.support: Epoch: 'selling export-controlled chips is not illegal within China'; Reuters: buying, selling and repair of Nvidia GPUs is 'not illegal in China'
claims.note: Supports brief's final line of Section 3 (Chinese domestic law).

claims.text_ko: Epoch에 따르면 2024년 4월~2025년 6월 중국은 말레이시아산 서버 38억 달러어치 수입을 기록했지만 말레이시아의 대중 수출 기록은 6억 달러였다.
claims.support: Between April 2024 and June 2025, China recorded $3.8 billion of server imports from Malaysia. Malaysia recorded only $0.6 billion of exports to China.
claims.note: Analysis section gives $3.75B.

claims.text_ko: 대수는 말레이시아 신고 3만 6,700대, 중국 기록 3만 5,500대로 비슷했다.
claims.support: 36,700 declared by Malaysia, 35,500 recorded by China

claims.text_ko: 대당 신고가는 말레이시아 출항 약 1만 7,000달러, 중국 도착 10만 6,000달러였다.
claims.support: about $17,000 each leaving Malaysia, compared with $106,000 arriving in China

claims.text_ko: 이 흐름은 미국이 A800·H800 수출을 막은 지 몇 달 뒤 시작됐다.
claims.support: This flow began a few months after [the US banned exports of Nvidia's A800/H800 GPUs to China]
claims.note: The A800/H800 ban came with the October 2023 rule.

claims.text_ko: 말레이시아가 2025년 7월 AI 칩 수출·환적 허가제를 도입하자 흐름은 몇 주 만에 무너졌다.
claims.support: collapsed within weeks of [Malaysia requiring a permit to export or transship high-performance AI chips]
claims.note: Exact day of the Malaysian rule not stated in the excerpt; July 2025.

claims.text_ko: Epoch은 이 패턴이 전용을 증명하진 않지만 밀수 사례와 맞아떨어진다고 밝혔다.
claims.support: While not proving diversion, this pattern is consistent with [established chip smuggling cases]

claims.text_ko: 로이터는 2025년 7월 선전의 한 수리 업체가 엔비디아 AI 칩을 한 달 최대 500개 고친다고 보도했다.
claims.support: now repairs up to 500 Nvidia AI chips per month
claims.note: Mostly H100, also A100. Roughly a dozen boutique firms offer such services.

claims.text_ko: 한 업체의 수리비는 개당 1만~2만 위안이다.
claims.support: charges between 10,000 yuan and 20,000 yuan ($1,400 to $2,800) to fix a GPU
claims.note: A different firm charges about 10% of the GPU's original price.

claims.text_ko: 엔비디아는 중국에서 제한 제품의 수리·교체를 법적으로 제공할 수 없다.
claims.support: Nvidia cannot legally provide repair or replacement items for restricted products in China.
claims.note: Nvidia spokesperson: 'Using restricted products without approved hardware, software, and technical support is a nonstarter'.

discrepancies: Sec.1 bullet 1: the brief says the surveillance photo shows 'a woman'; no source read identifies the person's gender. DOJ attributes the hair-dryer work to Sun and 'Broker-1'; Engadget (summarizing Bloomberg) says 'someone'. Engadget calls it a surveillance video; the DOJ release includes still images. The country of the warehouse is not explicitly stated (a warehouse rented by Company-1, a Southeast Asia-based company).
Sec.1 bullet 1 cites Bloomberg 10/01 as the source of the photo; the material was released by DOJ on 2026-03-19. Bloomberg's Oct 1 feature (paywalled) re-reported it.

Sec.1 bullet 2: 'three warehouses' appears only in Fortune 11/10; the DOJ release text describes dummy servers staged at a warehouse for an August 2025 audit, plus a Commerce inspection. Fortune also specifies the GPUs were H200 and B200, which the brief omits.

Sec.3 bullet 1 (pass-through): the brief attributes '$510M in April–May 2025 per Epoch' to Fortune 11/10. Fortune 11/10 does not mention $510M or Epoch. The figure is in the DOJ release ('late April to mid-May 2025', roughly three weeks) and the Epoch blog.
Sec.3 bullet 1: OBON is identified as the Bangkok company by Bloomberg's anonymous sources and short seller Culper, not by the indictment, which says 'Company-1'.

Sec.3 bullet 2 (Hao Global): '>$50M wired from China' and the Oct 2024–May 2025 period are in the DOJ release, not the Arnold & Porter blog the brief cites. The plea date is 2025-10-10, announced 2025-12-08. Fortune 5/13 does not mention Hao Global.
Sec.3 bullet 2 (Florida): the brief cites only Fortune 5/13. The primary source is the DOJ/M.D. Fla. release of 2025-11-20 (Janford Realtor LLC). Fortune says '400', not 'about 400'.

Sec.3 bullet 3 (Georgia): the brief cites no source. Sources are DOJ N.D. Ga. (2026-03-25) and Fortune 5/13. Per DOJ, the $170M / 750-server order failed because the server maker raised red flags and the chip maker (Nvidia per The Register) could not verify the Thai end user. That is two companies' checks, not only 'the seller's compliance'.

Sec.3 bullet 4 (Taiwan): routes were Indonesia (50) and Japan→Hong Kong (8). The brief omits Hong Kong. The May 20 raid was reported at the time (Focus Taiwan 5/22) as seizing 50 servers; the 56 figure comes from the August indictment and Bloomberg coverage. Chang's title varies (distribution manager / senior partner manager / senior manager). Defendant count is 9 per AP/TNW but '8 indicted' per CNA. Some secondary reports say GB300; primary-leaning sources (CNA, TNW, AP) say B300.

Sec.3 bullet 4: Bloomberg 11/15 also reports that Nvidia sought TSMC's advice (TSMC declined) and that officials said they had no role. The brief's 'conveyed concerns to political figures' is consistent but should be attributed to anonymous sources.
Sec.5 repair bullet: the Reuters article date is 2025-07-24. The '500/month' figure is for one repair affiliate, and the 10,000–20,000 yuan fee is for one (possibly different) firm.
